title: PromptyHelper.normalize crashes with TypeError on unset legacy ${VAR} env reference
body:
## Bug

`PromptyHelper.normalize()` raises `TypeError: object of type 'NoneType' has no len()` when a legacy bare `${VAR}` reference points at an unset environment variable. The crash happens before the documented `${VAR:default}` fallback can fire, so any `.prompty` file using a bare `${API_KEY}` style ref for an unset var fails to load.

`dapr_agents/prompt/utils/prompty.py` (around L202):

```python
v = PromptyHelper.process_env(variable[0], False)
if len(v) == 0:                 # v is None when the var is unset -> TypeError
    if len(variable) > 1:
        return variable[1]      # default value, never reached
    ...
```

`process_env(var, env_error=False)` is `os.getenv(var, None)`, so `v` is `None` when unset and `len(None)` blows up. The sibling helper `resolve_env` (same file, L135) already handles this with `if not result and len(variable) > 1`.

## Impact

`normalize` is called by `Prompty.load()` over the whole frontmatter, which is the entry point for `from_prompty` on every chat client (openai, anthropic, huggingface, dapr, mistral, nvidia). A spec with `api_key: ${AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY}` and the var unset crashes the whole load with a cryptic TypeError instead of returning the default / raising a clear "not found" error.

## Repro

```python
from dapr_agents.prompt.utils.prompty import PromptyHelper

PromptyHelper.normalize("${DA_MISSING:fallback}")  # expect "fallback", got TypeError
PromptyHelper.normalize("${DA_MISSING}", env_error=False)  # expect None, got TypeError
```

## Fix

Guard with `if not v:` (None-safe, mirrors `resolve_env`). Small fix + regression test; happy to open the PR.

linked_prs.title: fix(prompt): handle unset ${VAR} in PromptyHelper.normalize
linked_prs.patch:
diff --git a/dapr_agents/prompt/utils/prompty.py b/dapr_agents/prompt/utils/prompty.py
index fbf3b7957..a20bf1d97 100644
--- a/dapr_agents/prompt/utils/prompty.py
+++ b/dapr_agents/prompt/utils/prompty.py
@@ -200,7 +200,7 @@ def normalize(
                     return PromptyHelper.process_file(variable[1], parent)
                 else:
                     v = PromptyHelper.process_env(variable[0], False)
-                    if len(v) == 0:
+                    if not v:
                         if len(variable) > 1:
                             return variable[1]
                         elif env_error:
diff --git a/tests/prompt/test_prompty.py b/tests/prompt/test_prompty.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..9460eefbc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/prompt/test_prompty.py
@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@

+"""Unit tests for PromptyHelper.normalize() environment variable resolution."""
+
+from dapr_agents.prompt.utils.prompty import PromptyHelper
+
+
+class TestPromptyHelperNormalize:
+    """Tests for PromptyHelper.normalize() with ${VAR} env references."""
+
+    def test_legacy_default_used_when_var_unset(self, monkeypatch):
+        """${VAR:default} returns the default when the env var is unset."""
+        monkeypatch.delenv("DA_NORMALIZE_MISSING", raising=False)
+        assert PromptyHelper.normalize("${DA_NORMALIZE_MISSING:fallback}") == "fallback"
+
+    def test_unset_var_without_default_returns_none(self, monkeypatch):
+        """${VAR} with no default returns None when env_error is False."""
+        monkeypatch.delenv("DA_NORMALIZE_MISSING", raising=False)
+        assert (
+            PromptyHelper.normalize("${DA_NORMALIZE_MISSING}", env_error=False) is None
+        )
+
+    def test_set_var_round_trips(self, monkeypatch):
+        """${VAR} returns the env value when the variable is set."""
+        monkeypatch.setenv("DA_NORMALIZE_SET", "xyz")
+        assert PromptyHelper.normalize("${DA_NORMALIZE_SET}") == "xyz"
+
+    def test_env_prefixed_default_still_works(self, monkeypatch):
+        """${env:NAME:default} still falls back to the default when unset."""
+        monkeypatch.delenv("DA_NORMALIZE_MISSING", raising=False)
+        assert PromptyHelper.normalize("${env:DA_NORMALIZE_MISSING:def}") == "def"
+
+    def test_plain_string_unchanged(self):
+        """A plain string is returned unchanged."""
+        assert PromptyHelper.normalize("hello") == "hello"
